title: zoto-viz unified plugin
description:
Canonical schema for a zoto-viz plugin. First-party trees live at `plugins/src/<id>/`. A zip (`<id>.zip`) is the contrib / interchange format (`plugin add`, drop into `plugins/`, MCP `install_plugin_zip`).

Folder layout (convention-over-config; only plugin.yml is required):
  plugin.yml                 required metadata (this document)
  visualisation.yml          optional engine / base / look / style / layout / options / config
  frontend/**                optional TypeScript module (+ tests)
  sky/sky.yml                optional sky recipe / pins (AI-generated or hand-authored)
  sky/fragment.glsl          optional custom far-field GLSL (see $defs/shader)
  datasource/streams.yml     optional consumes[] / produces[] + field remaps
  datasource/collector.py    optional trusted collector (consent + ZOTO_VIZ_PLUGIN_SERVICE)
  backend/service.py         optional on_snapshot / setup / teardown hooks

Zip contract (enforced by service/plugin_zip.py):
  required member: plugin.yml at the archive root
  size limits: 12000000 bytes compressed (12 MB), 24000000 bytes uncompressed (24 MB), at most 80 files
  allowed suffixes: .yml .yaml .json .py .ts .tsx .js .mjs .css .html .md .txt .svg .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .glsl
  hard rejects: absolute paths, `..` traversal, symlinks

Plugin shader uniform contract (sky/fragment.glsl; subtask 07 enforces at compile time):
  allowed uniforms: uTime (float), uOpacity (float), uBright (float), uAudio (float), uAccent (vec3), uBg (vec3)
  plus varying `in vec3 vDir` from the shipped vertex program
  exclude uMode (shipped-enum index — implementation-specific)
  exclude AI Dynamic uniforms uMotif / uA / uB / uWarp / uGrain / uBands (private state)

id.description: Stable plugin id. The live view is addressed as plugin:<id>.

kind.description: When data-source, the tree ships public feed metadata and bundled demo snapshots only (no view menu row). Omit for normal view plugins.

dataSource.description: Required when kind is data-source: declared hosts, refresh policy, and bundled demo snapshots per source.

picker.description: hidden: test / fixture packs. The view never shows in the view picker, the mosaic pane pickers, dice or dream-cycle picks, but it can still be opened by id (URL, MCP, a saved layout). Omit for normal views.

entry.description: TypeScript/JS module relative to the plugin root (typically frontend/index.ts).

bundle.description: When false, the monitor serves the entry file verbatim (preserves relative imports for pack-assets).

entry.description: Python hooks relative to the plugin root (typically backend/service.py).
Legacy view-plugin TypeScript entry (directory plugin). Prefer frontend.entry.

service.description: Legacy view-plugin Python path. Prefer backend.entry / backend/service.py.

runtime.description: Legacy view-plugin runtime flag. typescript requires entry or frontend.entry.

capabilities.description: Frontend host API allowlist. camera, mic, parent DOM, and network are never granted. viz.read receives host-decimated data frames; viz.write fills reserved buffer/uniform slots (see $defs/vizContract). typesafe opts into lazy TypeSafe/Jev Sense (shadow plugin_state only — see $defs/typesafeContract).

viz.description: VizPlugin contract: caps, buffer slots, particle limit, no full-graph walk. Required when viz.read or viz.write is declared.

assets.description: Host-loaded mesh/texture assets (GLB/glTF/etc.). Digested into consent as assets_sha256.

render.description: Optional host-owned render hints. When render.scale is set, the web host runs a per-view adaptive render-scale governor (GPU-timed when available) and exposes uResolution (scaled render size) plus optional opt-in uRenderScale host uniform.

typesafe.description: Optional TypeSafe/Jev contract (or inline typesafe.yml merge). Dark by default — host lazy-loads SDK only when typesafe capability is declared and the user opts in.

overlay.description: When true or a mode/plugin id, this plugin overlays look onto that catalog row instead of adding a second view.

mode_id.description: Optional catalog id to overlay when it differs from `id`.

instances.description: Named catalog rows that reuse this plugin tree with different source / field / filter defaults. View id is plugin:<id> when instance id equals the plugin id, otherwise plugin:<id>:<instance>.

library.description: Source-library id or list (open-meteo, usgs-quakes, bbc-news). A list combines recipes. Polling starts when Settings or set_source adds the row.

scripts.description: Legacy scripts map. Retired in the unified layout (frontend/ + backend/).

ui.description: Legacy ui block. generate-UI is not part of unified v1.

skills.description: Legacy skills paths. Not part of unified v1.

zoto_sdk_version.description: Pack SDK / manifest contract version; values above the host support appear in Blocked.

presetField.description: Config key holding the active preset id (prefer settings.presetField).

engine.description: Visualisation engine. Known values today: graph, netpong, invaders, command, frogger, cpupong, doom, waves, orbits, helix, skyline, pacman, tetris, portal, carousel. Open (not a closed enum) so new engines still validate.

base.description: Graph wrap target when engine is graph. Known values today: topology, talkers, services, protocols, layers, drone-show, watch, wifi, bluetooth, cpu, cores, load, sources, memory, disk, gpu, sockets, cgroups, units, udev, bridge. Open so new wrap targets do not need a schema bump.

freeMap.description: Legacy free-form object map (options/config as key→field objects). Lists use pluginConfigList.

freeObject.description: Free-form object map (additionalProperties: true). Used for plugin config objects so oneOf with pluginConfigList stays unambiguous.

look.description: Per-view look pins. Free-form map (additionalProperties: true) — do not treat any look key as required; web/src/core/modes.ts and web/src/plugins/plugin.ts grow one-off knobs faster than this schema can track. Keys that exist in the codebase today (hints only, not required): theme, chrome, backdrop, stageOnly, skyOpacity, skyBright, skySpeed, skyEase, skyAudio, skyCycle, bgColor, bgOpacity, bgAudio, gridShape, gridColor, gridSize, gridFollow, gridOpacity, gridBright, gridAudio, audioDrive, audioSens, audioCamera, audioNodes, themeCycle, edgeGlow, edgeGlowAmt, edgeGlowSpeed, graphFabric (off|tubes|cloth|ribbon), graphSpace (auto|space|plane), graphLayout (auto|force|tree|radial|concentric|cluster|dag|globe|bars|scatter|helix|vortex|bloom|ripple|weave|cascade|knot|hourglass|coral|tide|mobius|spine|halo|fold|drift|sierpinski|hilbert|koch|julia|spectrum|waterfall|carrier|phased|heap|trie|hashmap|matrix|queue), graphLinks (auto|arrows|bundle|both), mosaic (4|6|8), hero (off|left|center|right), mosaicTiles (catalog view ids), mosaicSharedTheme. mosaic + mosaicTiles open a split wall when the plugin is selected (Syscon uses this). stageOnly defaults on for demo packs (viz.read/write, backdrop plugin, or a sky shader); set false to keep the LAN graph. Related ViewMode knobs (not look-schema-required): graphBase, arcadeId, flatten, camera, standalone, fabric. Theme ids today: midnight, ocean, nord, dracula, solarized, gruvbox, ember, neon, tactical, paper, dusk, void, vhs, acid, ice, phosphor. BackdropKind today: none, fractal, space, matrix, live, aurora, rain, ocean, fire, warp, clouds, circuit, plasma, lattice, dusk, void, vhs, nebula, acid, ice, dawn, phosphor, earth, meadow, tunnel, dynamic, custom, plugin. FloorShape today: square, hex, triangle, diamond, circle. Fields that are NOT in the current codebase and must not be gated: chromatic, film_noise, film_flicker, halo, drop_amount, cursor_pulse, aim_size, target_size, scanline, follow_zoom_curve, follow_zoom_max, follow_zoom_min.

style.description: Free-form style map. Keys used today (hints only): nodeColor (role|kind|heat|proto|hash), nodeScale (default|bytes|rate), labels (default|all|none|top), flatten, fabric (true|tubes|cloth|ribbon — nodes and edges become an animated mesh with the same hover/selection/glow), library (style-library id or list, e.g. orbit-helix or [jelly-bloom, neon-halo]). library combines recipes left to right; fabric/flatten on the same map extend the result. Explicit look.graphLayout / graphSpace / graphLinks still win.

layout.description: Free-form layout map. Keys used today (hints only): lanShell, internetShell.

defaults.description: Per-instance config defaults applied before pack-wide fallback.

streamRef.description: A monitor stream this plugin consumes or produces. Known names today (not a closed enum): devices, flows, packets, traffic, wifi, bluetooth, cpu, audio, feed, graph, hud, plugin_state, rf, sources. Objects may remap fields.

visualisation.title: visualisation.yml
visualisation.description: Optional visualisation.yml at the plugin root. engine/base wrap a host graph or arcade engine; look/style/layout/options/config are free-form maps.

datasource.description: Optional library ids this view wants. Same ids as list_source_library.

dataMapping.description: Maps host data fields to visual effects (pack-specific rows; parsed in frontend).

manifestWorkBudget.title: workBudget
manifestWorkBudget.description: Per-frame work caps (shape in plugins/sdk); host ceilings in service/policy/work-budget-ceilings.json (#45).

sky.title: sky.yml
sky.description: Optional sky/sky.yml. Additive: recipe/pins/notes are optional so both AI-generated (SkyRecipe) and hand-authored skies validate. Do not lock the shape.

streams.title: streams.yml
streams.description: Optional datasource/streams.yml. consumes[] names monitor streams (plus optional field remaps); produces[] names streams the collector emits; bindings are frontend-visible.

renderScale.title: Adaptive render-scale governor
renderScale.description: Host steps down when p95 frame time stays over the 16.7 ms budget for ~0.5 s and steps up after ~2 s under 80% of budget. Packs never implement their own governor.

min.description: Lowest allowed render scale (must be > 0 and at most 1).

steps.description: Descending allowed scales clamped at or above min. Defaults to [1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.35].

vizUboLayout.title: VizPlugin GLSL UBO binding
vizUboLayout.description: Fixed std140 buffer→shader layout for all viz packs. Slot `s` float `f` maps to `zotoVizSlots[s * 16 + f / 4][f % 4]` in the host preamble. Per-pack vertex attributes are a later escape hatch, not the default transport.

typesafeContract.title: TypeSafe/Jev opt-in contract
typesafeContract.description: Shadow-channel only: results land in plugin_state.typesafe, never UBO or viz skip paths. Optional typesafe.yml at plugin root may supply the same shape.

questions.description: Optional Sense prompts passed to Jev when enabled.

stateRemap.description: Rename top-level monitor state keys before Sense (e.g. devices → nodes).

vizIdleSeed.title: Inline viz idle seed
vizIdleSeed.description: Static demo slices merged when the live monitor frame has empty packets/rf/talkers/headlines. Live non-empty slices always win.

vizIdle.title: Viz idle fallback
vizIdle.description: Required when viz.read or viz.write is declared. Either { fixture: "host" } for the shared host VizDataFrame demo seed, or an inline seed object. Live monitor traffic always wins when a slice is non-empty; idle fills empty slices only and must stay within the 16.7 ms present-time budget (no hotter path than live).

fixture.description: Use buildIdleVizFrame() — modest demo packets, RF beacons, talkers, and headlines.

vizContract.title: VizPlugin host contract
vizContract.description: Host owns ingest and the 16.7 ms frame budget. Plugins consume pre-decimated VizDataFrames and write only to reserved buffer/uniform slots declared here. graphWalk must be false — plugins never traverse the full device graph per frame. Buffer slots bind through the fixed UBO in $defs/vizUboLayout (separate from graph.read monitor plugins). When viz.read or viz.write is declared, idle is required — live slices win over idle when non-empty.

contract.description: VizDataFrame slice version the host delivers to this pack. Omit for v1 (lifetime talker counts, no links or talkers[].failed). Use 2 for live packet rates, links, and per-host TCP failure ratios.

ubo.description: Optional explicit pin; omit to use the fixed host layout. When present every field must match the const values.

maxBuffers.description: Reserved Float32 buffer slots the plugin may write per frame.

maxBufferFloats.description: Maximum floats per buffer slot write.

maxParticles.description: Hard cap on particle records per frame (0 disables writeParticles).

graphWalk.description: Must be false. Enforced at validate time and runtime.

presentTick.description: When true with viz.write, the host delivers rAF present timestamps to the sandbox so the pack can advance simulation on its own clock.

hostMeshSlot.description: Sandbox buffer slot carrying column-major 4×4 matrices for host-owned GLTF instancing (see HostMeshLane). Sim data may use other slots when this is not 2.

hostMeshSlotCount.description: Number of consecutive buffer slots starting at hostMeshSlot used for host mesh draw batches.

uniforms.description: Sky uniforms this plugin may write via viz.write (subset of $defs/shader allowedUniforms).

idle.description: Demo frame fallback when live monitor slices are empty. Required with viz.read or viz.write.

mayBeStatic.description: When true, the host tile-health probe skips the stillness (no new frames) empty rule. Flat/uniform panels are still detected.

shader.title: Plugin sky fragment uniform contract
shader.description: sky/fragment.glsl may declare and read only these uniforms: uTime (float), uOpacity (float), uBright (float), uAudio (float), uAccent (vec3), uBg (vec3), plus varying in vec3 vDir from the shipped vertex program. Explicitly exclude uMode (shipped-enum index — implementation-specific). Explicitly exclude AI Dynamic uniforms uMotif / uA / uB / uWarp / uGrain / uBands (private state). Subtask 07 enforces the contract at compile time.

zipMember.description: Relative zip member path. Rejects `..`, absolute paths, and suffixes outside the allow-list (includes .glsl).

zipListing.title: Plugin zip member listing
zipListing.description: Frozen zip contract: plugin.yml required at the archive root; optional roots visualisation.yml, frontend/**, sky/sky.yml, sky/fragment.glsl, datasource/streams.yml, datasource/collector.py, backend/service.py. Limits: 12 MB compressed (12000000), 24 MB uncompressed (24000000), at most 80 files. Hard rejects: absolute paths, `..` traversal, symlinks.

zipContract.title: Plugin zip numeric contract
zipContract.description: Zip size and file-count limits (MAX_ZIP=12000000, MAX_UNCOMPRESSED=24MB, MAX_FILES=80). Runtime: service/plugin_zip.py.
